types.name: environmentHandle
types.description: The environment handle of the Arcangel Cloud environment.

types.name: sandboxHandle
types.description: The sandbox handle of the Arcangel Cloud sandbox.

types.name: apiKey
types.description: The API key used to access Arcangel Cloud services.

types.name: webhookSecret
types.description: The webhook secret used to verify webhooks.

types.name: paymentsEndpoint
types.description: The endpoint of the Arcangel Cloud payment service.

types.name: emailsEndpoint
types.description: The endpoint of the Arcangel Cloud email service.

types.name: searchEndpoint
types.description: The endpoint of the Arcangel Cloud search service.

types.name: oauthAuthorizeEndpoint
types.description: The authorization endpoint of the Arcangel Cloud OAuth service.

types.name: oauthTokenEndpoint
types.description: The token endpoint of the Arcangel Cloud OAuth token service.

types.name: oauthCallbackUrl
types.description: The callback URL for the Arcangel Cloud OAuth service. If not provided, it will be set to `${AdminOptions.backendUrl}/auth/user/cloud/callback`.

types.name: oauthDisabled
types.description: Whether the Arcangel Cloud OAuth service is disabled.

types.name: oauthJwksUri
types.description:
The JWKS URI for the Arcangel Cloud OAuth service. This is used to verify the JWT tokens issued by the Arcangel Cloud OAuth service.
If not provided, an error is thrown when trying to use the Arcangel Cloud OAuth service.

types.name: oauthAudience
types.description:
The expected `aud` claim of id\_tokens issued by the Arcangel Cloud OAuth service.
If not provided, an error is thrown when trying to use the Arcangel Cloud OAuth service.
